item.modpack.engineering_assembly.toolti: A starting component for mechanical engineering, crafted by hand from basic Earth materials.
item.modpack.information_interface.toolt: Connects industrial electronics with digital logistics. Manufacturing it requires no existing digital network.
item.modpack.heavy_industry_control.tool: Used in large production machines, engineering miners, and heavy defenses.
item.modpack.reactor_control.tooltip: A control component for atomic industry. Complete bench and backup-power tests first.
item.modpack.space_control_core.tooltip: Combines industrial circuits, heavy structures, and aerospace materials. Can be manufactured on Earth.
item.modpack.colony_maintenance.tooltip: For colony repairs and supplies. Consult the relevant facility instructions for supported uses.
item.modpack.quantum_control.tooltip: Used in quantum equipment and large logistics systems. Requires no boss drops or alien-exclusive materials.
item.modpack.anomaly_analysis.tooltip: Processes anomaly research findings and can also be manufactured through Earth industry.
item.modpack.industrial_console.tooltip: A charter blueprint issued when a base is registered, symbolizing its industrial hub.
item.modpack.armory_workbench.tooltip: A token chip symbolizing arms production and ammunition requisition rights.
item.modpack.logistics_console.tooltip: A token chip symbolizing stock targets and resupply priorities.
item.modpack.life_support_console.toolti: A token chip symbolizing oxygen, water, and habitat monitoring.
item.modpack.service_medal.tooltip: A commemorative reward for milestone quests; grants no ability or progression.
modpack.message.horde_warning: %1$s: a horde is expected in %2$s seconds. Check defenses and supplies.
modpack.message.horde_started: %1$s: the horde has arrived. Watch every defensive line.
modpack.message.horde_ended: %1$s: the attack has ended. Restock ammunition and inspect damaged facilities.
modpack.message.horde_deferred: %1$s: the attack has been deferred. A new warning will be issued in advance.
modpack.message.recovery_period: %1$s: %2$s minutes of recovery remain. No new base attack will begin during this period.
modpack.message.low_ammo: %1$s: ammunition reserves are low. Restock or adjust firepower.
modpack.message.low_power: %1$s: power is low. Prioritize oxygen and essential defenses.
modpack.message.low_oxygen: %1$s: oxygen reserves are low. Check power, oxygen supply, and compartment sealing.
modpack.message.supply_interrupted: %1$s: the supply link is interrupted. Local reserves are in use.
modpack.message.supply_restored: %1$s: the supply link has been restored.
modpack.message.station_event_warning: %1$s: a special event will begin in the quarantine zone in %2$s seconds. Leave the danger area.
modpack.message.station_event_ended: %1$s: the special event has ended. Normal station controls have resumed.
modpack.message.boss_detected: Dangerous individual detected: %1$s. You may engage or withdraw.
modpack.message.base_registered: Base %1$s has been registered. Industrial activity will be measured from local facilities.
modpack.message.threat_changed: %1$s: local threat is now %2$s. See base status for details.
modpack.message.manufacturing_denied: The owning team has not mastered %1$s. Manufacturing is paused.
modpack.message.return_reserve: Return reserves are low. Replenish fuel, oxygen, and food.
modpack.message.food_low: %1$s: food stock is low. Check kitchen and farm supply.
modpack.message.maintenance_due: %1$s: some facilities are due for maintenance. Efficiency has fallen back to baseline.
modpack.advancement.first_launch.title: First Launch
modpack.advancement.first_launch.descrip: Reach planetary orbit by rocket — the Space Age has begun.
modpack.message.tacz_turret_tip: An automatic turret needs a gun and matching ammunition. Keep a local ammo box under it and let logistics refill it.
modpack.message.drg_gun_tip: Deep Rock Galactic weapons are high-intensity equipment — superior firepower paired with much pricier ammunition logistics.
